title: Sanity-check my child EEG montage before I order caps
detail: I have a 32-channel layout for 5-7 year olds and no one in my lab has run paediatric EEG before. I mostly need someone to tell me if the coverage is wrong before I spend the budget.

title: Is my prior on the learning rate defensible?
detail: Fitting a simple RL model to EEG-derived trial estimates. I have a beta prior I cannot justify beyond 'it looked reasonable'. Fifteen minutes with someone who fits these properly would save me a reviewer comment.

title: Walk me through converting my behavioural data to BIDS
detail: I want to structure my MSc data properly from the start rather than fixing it later. Happy to come to you and take notes.

title: Borrow a sleep-scoring pipeline for a thesis chapter
detail: My undergraduate thesis has one overnight condition and I do not have time to build scoring from scratch. Any existing pipeline I can run would do.

title: Half an hour of MEG time to test whether an infant cap fits the array
detail: Not a study, just a feasibility check with no participant. Needs someone who can authorise and supervise a short slot.

title: How do you recruit older adults here?
detail: I need about 30 participants over 65 and no idea where to start. Even a pointer to whoever holds the participant list would help.

title: Anyone run studies in local schools before?
detail: Looking for a conversation about what the board actually requires and how long approval took. Would rather learn from someone's mistakes than repeat them.

title: Two people to read a draft preprocessing standard
detail: One page of proposed BIDS and preprocessing conventions for the department. I need it critiqued by people who would actually have to follow it, not by another technician.

title: Co-author on the modelling chapter of my thesis
detail: The honest version of my other ask. The final chapter needs a proper modelling collaborator, which is months of work, not minutes.

title: Teach me enough Praat to segment my stimuli
detail: I have 200 recorded words to segment and have never used Praat. A morning of supervised practice would get me self-sufficient.
